title: TripAdvisor Reviews Scraper
description: Extract hotel user reviews from one or more TripAdvisor hotel page URLs using the TripAdvisor reviews API.

startUrls.title: TripAdvisor hotel URLs
startUrls.description: TripAdvisor hotel review page URLs. Each URL must contain a hotel location identifier in the -d<locationId>- segment.

searchText.title: Review text filter
searchText.description: Return reviews whose TripAdvisor review text matches this search term. Leave empty to disable.

sortBy.title: Review sort order
sortBy.description: TripAdvisor API sort order applied before pagination.

lang.title: Review language
lang.description: Optional ISO language code filter, such as en or fr. Leave empty to disable.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of reviews
results_wanted.description: Maximum total number of unique reviews to collect across all startUrls.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages per hotel
max_pages.description: Maximum API pages to request for each hotel URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is required for stable extraction because TripAdvisor blocks datacenter IPs.
